headline: Decided against food trucks for the October 3 Senior Expo and moved the next meeting to prepare for it.
summary: Extended CART hours began today, and flyers have gone out around town. Ilona said 66 tables are confirmed for the Senior Expo, bringing in $1,450, and she expects 70-80 in total. A subcommittee will review Jim Green award nominees.
decisions: Approved moving the next meeting to September 29 to prepare for the Senior Expo, all in favor.
Continued review of the August and September minutes to the September 29 meeting.
Formed a subcommittee to review nominees for the Jim Green award.
Decided to focus CART promotion on seniors for now and keep spreading the word as they can.
Decided not to have food trucks at the Senior Expo this year.
Agreed to run the raffle baskets the same way as last year and review best practices after the expo.

decision_evidence.quote: Next Meeting October 6th; discussion to move next meeting to September 29 in preparation for Senior Expo. a. The committee was all in favor of this idea.
Both August and September minutes will be reviewed at the next meeting on September 29. Meridel motioned this and John seconded.
A sub-committee was formed for the Jim Green nomination. Sub-committee members are Deb, Lois, Meridel, Tom and Sherry.
The committee decided to focus on seniors for now and continue to get the word out as they can.
The committee decided to not have food trucks this year as it is fair season and we would like to keep it simple.
After a long discussion on raffle baskets, the committee will do what we did last year and revisit best practices after the expo.
